pitch.headline: Senior Product Designer & UX Strategist | Transforming Complex Data-Dense Workflows & Healthcare Operations Through AI-First Systems Design
pitch.fitAnalysis: Nicole is an exceptional fit for Medallion's Senior Product Designer role, directly aligning with the requirement for handling complex operational environments, automation, and AI-driven interfaces. As the Founder of a Stealth Health-tech Venture, she has hands-on experience architecting NLP-driven health-tech interfaces that translate semantic input into structured data—perfectly matching Medallion's focus on automation, routing, and exception handling. Furthermore, her current role at Allied Solutions demonstrates elite systems thinking where she utilizes an AI-first prototyping workflow (Cursor, Copilot, Figma Make) to ship data-heavy reporting interfaces, resulting in a perfect 5/5 SUPR-Q score. With over a decade of design maturity, including director-level experience at OneAmerica leading enterprise data and mobile architecture, Nicole possesses the deep technical fluency, information architecture mastery, and cross-functional leadership required to collaborate with Medallion's engineering teams and turn high-volume administrative bottlenecks into legible, trustworthy workflows.
pitch.coverLetterText:
Dear Hiring Team,

I have spent my career transforming dense, complex technical ecosystems into highly legible, trustworthy user experiences. When I read Medallion’s mission to eliminate the administrative bottlenecks in provider operations using automation and AI, it resonated deeply with my current work. As a Senior Product Designer and venture founder specializing in health-tech and enterprise workflows, I build scalable systems that reduce cognitive load and turn high-volume operational chaos into intuitive digital products.

Currently, as the Founder of a Stealth Health-tech Venture, I direct end-to-end product execution, notably architecting an AI-driven interface utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP) to translate complex semantic input into structured data. This directly mirrors Medallion's objective of making AI actions, routing, and decision support legible and reliable for operational teams. Additionally, as a Senior UX Designer at Allied Solutions, I lead the product design for data-dense reporting software. By pioneering an AI-first workflow utilizing tools like Cursor and Copilot, I cut down time-to-delivery while maintaining a rigorous standard of craft, ultimately driving the beta version to a perfect 5/5 SUPR-Q usability score.

Medallion’s emphasis on designers being 'builders, not just artifact makers' aligns perfectly with my operational mindset. Whether establishing foundational design systems and 3-year roadmaps as a UX Director at OneAmerica Financial or collaborating closely with engineering teams to reason through workflow logic and technical constraints, I ensure that design intent carries seamlessly into production. I bring a rare blend of deep information architecture expertise, modern AI-driven design practices, and a strong business acumen that connects UX outcomes directly to adoption and efficiency metrics.

I am eager to bring my background in healthcare technology, complex data systems, and cross-functional leadership to the Head of Design and the broader team at Medallion. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how my experience can help scale your provider operations platform.

Sincerely,

Nicole Whitis-Purva
